scope: Independent functional review of the installed Claude plugin report; private native Qt regression implementation, not a comprehensive security audit.

findings.effect: Vercel rotation/removal or same-value encrypted resave revoked unchanged GitHub handles and cancelled its pending requests.
findings.fix: Host synchronization validates definition/fields, updates only changed type/value and revokes that type. Missing records remove saved credentials. Unchanged definitions/values preserve handles and requests. On credential-store reload, source registry overrides are restored; explicit register/reset APIs keep their previous semantics.

findings.classification: Confirmed overbroad native cancellation policy; repaired privately
findings.effect: Disabling Figma, enabling a type or merely reordering the allow-list cancelled plain and unchanged GitHub requests.
findings.previousTestPolicy: tests/test_plugins.cpp deliberately expected the unchanged GitHub handle to rotate when Figma was disabled; this assertion is updated. Deletion callbacks now use affected credentialed requests, preserving their original lifetime coverage.
findings.fix: Revoke only removed types for the exact agent; cancel only requests pending at that transition that used a removed type. Plain, unchanged-type and other-agent requests survive. Re-enable creates a new removed-type handle. Explicit reset/cancel retains whole-agent semantics.

findings.classification: Confirmed header behavior mismatch; repaired privately
findings.effect: The supplied User-Agent was prefixed by the ADE default in actual QNetworkRequest headers.
findings.fix: Add the default only after caller headers if User-Agent is absent. Preserve case-insensitive repeated caller-header combination.

findings.classification: Existing explicit compatibility limit, unchanged; not a newly discovered credential boundary defect
findings.upstream: Pinned credential-fetch.ts delegates to native Node fetch without this explicit byte/deadline cap.
findings.decision: Retain the limits and honest large/slow response divergence. No speculative increase to 16 MiB; larger/streamed transfers require a separate worker IPC and memory design.

findings.classification: Additional reproduced callback regression; repaired privately
findings.effect: While old GitHub requests were cancelled, a completion observer saved/refreshed a newer Vercel token; the older outer refresh subsequently overwrote it.
findings.fix: Shared per-broker catalog operation token checks every callback boundary. Superseded refresh returns a clear error without clearing newer state or applying stale remaining records.

intentionalDifferencesPreserved: Five PAT credential definitions and allowed origins remain unchanged.
Disabled plugin types cannot obtain/use native handles; upstream only filters plugin skills.
Changed/removed types immediately revoke previously issued handles, stricter than pinned worker caches.
Response secret reflection checks, placeholder response URLs, manual credential redirects and header restrictions remain.
Read-only Settings token checks and PostHog region selection are native extensions.

Missing google-ai-key/stagewise-auth and unbundled Remotion/mini-apps/javascript-sandbox packages remain scope gaps; absent packages do not mean the separately implemented native mini-app/QuickJS features are absent.

before.sourcePhase: first private F1/F2/F3 repair, before catalog operation guard
private F2 repair before empty resolved-agent slot cleanup; not a defect in the old whole-agent reset implementation

validation.transport: New component tests use a fake QNetworkAccessManager which never delegates to an external transport. Actual Engine/QuickJS runtime tests use that fake plugin transport plus a synthetic loopback model server. Existing network/catalog regressions use loopback fixtures only.
validation.credentials: Synthetic fake values; encrypted temporary ProviderStore files only. No real credential/profile files, live service requests or external model calls.
validation.toolchain: Static Qt 6.11.2, GCC 16.2.0, Windows 11; copied coherent private archives/headers. Modified network/catalog and unchanged PluginConnectionService caller compiled privately. No shared builds or source writes.
validation.fixtureCorrection: Private CMake initially omitted the copied unchanged PluginConnectionService header; added it, then rebuilt all five final targets. This was a private harness include issue, not a production finding.

peerReview.scope: Source-only synchronizeCredential, setAllowedCredentialTypes, invalidation snapshots, catalog broker/operation guards
peerReview.result: No additional concrete callback defect found; no independent tests or broader broker review claimed.

integration.state: Private tested candidate, production unchanged; root integration/full gate pending
integration.headerDependency: Rebuild all PluginCatalog header consumers; do not reuse mixed old/new private-state template ABI.

limits: Focused functional scope only; no claim of complete plugin or network parity.
Global MainWindow refresh orchestration was not redesigned; operation protection here is per catalog broker.
Private test success is not a shared assembled application or packaged GUI validation.
